publication_api.method: 130 ordered cudaEventRecord calls: exclude first/last lifetime timing events; remaining 128 are update readiness records

decision: No measured hybrid crossover; preserve automatic sparse and explicit legal hybrid. No new optimization campaign.

methodology.cold_repeats: Three additional independent processes per mixed half route; one cold preparation observation per process, not seven.
methodology.accounted_lifetime_formula: (topology_prepare_ms + gradient_prepare_ms + h2d_ms + reset_ms + resident_wall_ms + observation_d2d_d2h_ms) / horizon
methodology.exclusions: Caller allocation/stream creation, fixture generation, independent validation, teardown, and cold transient peak are not timed. This is an accounted workload lifetime, not entire process latency.
methodology.memory: Core reported persistent and scratch plus exact live caller allocations; not a measured process-wide peak or preparation high-water mark.
methodology.operand_reuse: Fixed and refreshed versions both repack each step; no cache-speedup claim.
methodology.profile: Separate diagnostic traces; excluded from unprofiled distributions. Publication is host event-record API latency, not a GPU kernel.
methodology.correctness: Every sample validates independent rounded/full gradient and exact stored-f16 update recurrence; I05 independently validates forward/transpose.
methodology.numerical_tolerance: gradient absolute error <= 2e-5*(1+abs(independent reference)); exact f16 recurrence using actual GPU gradient; N1 forward same bound.
